info.title: Maatri-Shishu workspace API
info.description: Next.js route handlers backed by Supabase Auth and PostgreSQL RPC. Protected APIs are disabled in local demo mode. Date-only values use Gregorian YYYY-MM-DD; timestamps use ISO 8601. Mutation POSTs require an Origin matching the application's origin. All responses are private/no-store and have X-Request-Id. This contract documents the implemented API; it does not claim hosted integration or clinical approval.

post.summary: Sign in an individually provisioned staff account
Revoke the current session, including for disabled staff

get.summary: Read the full currently scoped snapshot and record workspace access
get.description: Returns assigned records only. Administrative roles receive schedules; ordinary staff receive only active schedules. Incremental cursor pagination is not implemented.

post.summary: Apply an idempotent, version-checked operation or atomic form batch
post.description: A batch contains 1–30 operations in parent-before-child order and commits entirely or rolls back entirely. Maximum serialized batch length: 90,000 characters; Content-Length above 100,000 is rejected. Retry identical operation IDs after uncertain delivery. A 409 requires explicit review; changing payload requires a new operation ID. Supplied role, actor or facility are never trusted; PostgreSQL derives them from auth.uid().

200.description: All writes committed, or identical receipts replayed

post.summary: Upload durable profile-read or print metadata
post.description: Idempotent by staff account and access-event ID. The observation time is device supplied; the database separately records receipt time. No patient narrative is accepted. Current account and record scope are rechecked.

get.summary: Export scoped records as audited JSON
get.description: Health workers and supervisors only. This is a data export, not a complete database backup or restore format.

staffSession.name: sb-<project-ref>-auth-token
staffSession.description: Project-specific Supabase SSR cookie (possibly chunked). Issued and refreshed on the server; HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, Secure in production. The browser does not receive a JavaScript-readable auth token.

data.description: Full entity payload using the matching entityType schema; empty for approval transitions.
